title: Study in China
tagline: Language year, bachelor’s and master’s degrees. Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC).
intro:
China is one of Asia’s leading destinations for international students. Chinese language skills open careers in trade, logistics and international business, and scholarships make study affordable.

We shortlist universities, help you apply for the CSC scholarship and obtain the student visa.

sections.heading: Programs
sections.body:
**Language year.** Intensive Chinese — ideal for beginners and HSK preparation.

**Bachelor’s and master’s.** Taught in Chinese (usually HSK 4–5) or in English for some programs.

sections.heading: CSC scholarship
sections.body: The **Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)** can cover tuition, accommodation, insurance and a monthly stipend. Applications usually open early in the year — prepare in advance.

documents: HSK or IELTS/TOEFL certificate (depending on the program)

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We choose the university, language of study and scholarship.

steps.title: Documents
steps.text: We prepare translations, the study plan and the medical form.

steps.title: Application
steps.text: We apply to the university and for the scholarship.

steps.title: X1/X2 visa
steps.text: We obtain the JW202 and the visa.

faq.a: Yes — through a language year or English-taught programs.

faq.q: What does the CSC scholarship cover?
faq.a: A full scholarship usually includes tuition, dormitory, medical insurance and a monthly stipend. Terms depend on the scholarship type.
September intakes usually open in winter, and scholarships early in the year. Start preparing 6–9 months ahead.
